title: Signing in to a Celerp account
summary: Web Access links this installation to a Celerp account, the sign-in Connect, backups, the module marketplace and Celerp AI's free questions all use.

steps.text: Open {access} from Settings. If you already subscribed on the Celerp website, use {connect} to link that account to this installation; the same account unlocks Celerp Connect, cloud backups, the module marketplace and Celerp AI's free questions.
